title: Small-scale Expression and Solubility Testing of Proteins in BL21 E. coli
author: Vincent A Bielinski

steps.title: Grow and Induce BL21 Cells
steps.instruction: Grow and induce BL21 cells in a medium of choice using appropriate temperature and inducer conditions.

substeps.instruction: Example conditions: Terrific Broth cultured at 30°C, with overnight induction at 18°C using 1mM IPTG or 0.5% L-arabinose.

steps.title: Harvest Expression Culture
steps.instruction: Harvest 10 mL of the overnight expression culture by centrifugation for 10 minutes at 3000 x g.

steps.title: Resuspend Cell Pellet
steps.instruction: Remove the supernatant by decanting and resuspend the pellet in 800 uL Lysis Buffer.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the cell suspension to a new 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube.

steps.title: Lyse Cells
steps.instruction: Sonicate the suspension as appropriate for complete cell lysis, using settings specific to the sonicator make and model.

steps.title: Clarify Lysates
steps.instruction: Clarify the lysates by centrifugation at 4°C for 10 minutes at 12,000-15,000 x g.

steps.title: Equilibrate Talon Resin
steps.instruction: Equilibrate the Talon resin (supplied as a 50% slurry in ethanol) by washing 3x with 5 volumes of resin bedding.

substeps.instruction: Calculate required resin: 25 uL of equilibrated resin is needed per pulldown (e.g., for 8 pulldowns, estimate for 10).
Shake the slurry well and transfer 500 uL of resin slurry to a new Eppendorf tube.
Pellet resin by spinning in a microfuge for 30 seconds at 3000 x g.
Remove supernatant carefully and add 1 mL of Lysis Buffer.
Vortex resin briefly, pellet again, and repeat the wash with 1 mL of Lysis Buffer two more times.
After the third spin, remove supernatant and add 250 uL of Lysis Buffer to produce 500 uL of equilibrated resin.

steps.title: Bind Protein to Resin
steps.instruction: Combine the clarified supernatant with equilibrated resin and incubate.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 750 uL of clarified supernatant to a new Eppendorf tube.
Add 50 uL of equilibrated resin to each tube.
Incubate for 1 hour at room temperature (RT) with end-over-end mixing.

steps.title: Recover Resin
steps.instruction: Pellet the resin by spinning for 1 minute at 3000 x g at RT, then remove the supernatant with a pipette.

steps.title: Wash Resin
steps.instruction: Wash the resin 3x with 1 mL of Wash Buffer.

substeps.instruction: Pellet the resin between each wash and remove the supernatant.

steps.title: Elute Protein
steps.instruction: Elute the protein from the resin using Elution Buffer.

substeps.instruction: After the third wash, remove supernatant and resuspend resin in 50 uL of Elution Buffer.
Quickly spin down beads and transfer the eluate to a clean Eppendorf tube.
Repeat the elution process again, combining eluates into a single tube (total 100 uL eluate).

steps.title: Analyze Eluate
steps.instruction: Analyze 5-10 uL of the eluate on an SDS gel and stain with Coomassie blue.
